results.title: What is Textile FX? | Textile FX
results.description: Textile FX is an instant FX rail for stablecoins. It moves value between non-USD assets (cNGN for the Nigerian naira, wARS for the Argentine peso, wBRL for the Brazilian real, IDRX for the Indonesian rupiah, WETH for wrapped ether) and USD stablecoins (USDT and USDC), fully on-chain. Moving money between a currency and dollars is normally slow and expensive. Correspondent banks, OTC desks, multi-day settlement.
